name: OpenCage Geocoding
tagline: Forward and reverse geocoding with global coverage
description: OpenCage Geocoding API converts addresses to coordinates and coordinates to addresses using aggregated open data. It provides structured place data, timezone, annotations, and confidence scores for apps that need reliable place lookup worldwide.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (self-serve signup)

use_cases: convert a street address to latitude/longitude
reverse-geocode coordinates to a place name
look up timezone for a location
